questions.question: Briefly explain the Saturation mode of operation of a BJT
questions.solution_html:
• In saturation mode, both the base–emitter and base–collector junctions are forward
  • biased. The transistor conducts heavily, and collector current is maximum and
  • independent of base current. Collector-emitter voltage (Vce) drops to a low value
  • (~0.2V). The transistor behaves like a closed switch.
  • Marks distribution: Definition (2), Junction condition (1), Characteristics (2) = 5
